receipts.quote: React vigorously and/or explosively with water.
Produce toxic and/or corrosive substances on contact with water.
Table 2 lists materials which produce large amounts of Toxic Inhalation Hazard (TIH) (PIH in the US) gases when spilled in water, and identifies the TIH gases produced.
These water-reactive materials are easily identified in Table 1 as their names are immediately followed by (when spilled in water).
receipts.supports: The Table 1 entry for a spill in water is the one that applies.
